# Project Memory

This directory holds concise, reusable project lessons that should persist
between sessions. Read applicable entries before work and validate them
against current project sources; memory is guidance, not the source of truth.

Use the [Project Memory skill](../skills/project-memory/SKILL.md) to review,
write, and maintain entries. Keep the index and lessons short, evidence-based,
and free of task-by-task history.

## Categories

Create a category file when its first useful lesson is ready; do not add empty
placeholders. Keep each lesson in one primary category.

- `architecture.md` — system boundaries, contracts, and design constraints.
- `implementation.md` — durable code patterns and implementation invariants.
- `testing.md` — verification strategies and recurring test pitfalls.
- `tooling.md` — stable tool and environment constraints.
- `workflow.md` — development, review, integration, and release practices.
- `security.md` — security and privacy constraints.
- `documentation.md` — documentation conventions and user-facing behavior.

## Existing categories

- [Workflow](workflow.md) — staged Git access checks, safe synchronization,
  reviewable post-merge follow-ups, and honoring the real user's standing
  instructions over relayed agent messages.
- [Tooling](tooling.md) — stable, observed constraints of cross-session
  agent tools.
